text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah――phew!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, feels good.
I guess that's enough for today's voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bouquet!
Just finishing up your self-training?
Care to walk back together?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, I'm sorry. I appreciate the thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I was just about
to start my training."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh, right now? The sun's about to set, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—I had planned
to start a bit earlier as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: On my way to training, I saw someone standing completely still.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I thought they might need some help...
and before I knew it, it had gotten this late.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing that smile... hehe.
I feel refreshed and ready to
devote myself to training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Is that so?
...Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've decided.
I'm joining you for your independent training!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ai-san is...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Training with a partner lets you work out
far more efficiently in a shorter time.
Well? Not a bad proposition, is it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I deeply appreciate your concern, but...
Are you going to be all right, Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you training
just a moment ago?
And yet, taking time to accompany me like this...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you worried about me?
In that case... let me assure you there's no need to be!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ! What incredible acceleration—...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, haah, haah...!
See? I can totally keep running, right...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If I still have strength left, I have to give it everything.
...That's the only way I can get closer to my ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Extra training? I'd love to!
Let's get started, Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ai-san...
Yes, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, truly—well then, shall we start with flexibility exercises?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Hehe, the wind feels so nice!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That was a very fulfilling training session.
Thanks, Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh...! N-No... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it's just kind of funny...
When really, I'm the one who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Really? But I truly mean it.
I feel like I've gotten a step stronger!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, why don't we stop by a convenience store on the way back?
It's gotten a bit late, and
getting proper nutrition is important, after all."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, with pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Phew. ...Thank you very much,
that was a very meaningful training run.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Hehe, same here...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To push myself this hard to the absolute limit...
It's so difficult to do it alone...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Pushing yourself that hard...
Thank you so much for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, may I brew some herbal tea
as a token of my gratitude?
I'm sure it will help ease your mind.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hehe, with pleasure.
Your herbal tea really soothes a tired body, Bouquet-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —*pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(To push this much load onto herself...
Is it precisely because time is limited?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of you, Bouquet-chan.
...But I won't lose either—!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ! Pushing yourself even further...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, as expected, Ai-san is incredible.
I have to give it everything I've got, too!
